units.source_text: “嗯，有没有化妆修成佛这么一说呢？

en.t: Well, is there such a thing as becoming a Buddha through makeup?

units.source_text: 彻悟而入道，随处都会有。

en.t: If one awakens completely and enters the Way, it can be found everywhere.

units.source_text: 显微镜里、化妆镜里也都会有。”

en.t: It is there inside the microscope, and inside the makeup mirror too.
